ModMetaData.name: Essencebound v0.14 — RimWorld 1.7
ModMetaData.author: Essencebound Project
ModMetaData.description: Essencebound v0.14: colony-strength-driven magic density based on wealth, population, combat skill and Essencebound essence advancement. Astral tear frequency and monster danger now scale with colony progression. Includes manifestation monsters, Astral Loot, ranked abilities and configurable slots. Experimental RimWorld 1.7; test saves recommended.
